market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: Winning the Stanley Cup requires surviving four playoff rounds against strong competition. Even elite teams rarely exceed a 10-15% preseason probability. The Hurricanes have a solid core but not a dominant championship caliber, and the implied 37.5% is vastly inflated relative to realistic expectations for any single team in a 32-team league.
evidence_points: Historical preseason Cup odds rarely exceed 10% for any team
Hurricanes playoff performance: lost in second round 2024, lack recent Cup finals appearances
NHL parity makes it unlikely any team holds 37.5% chance this far out
sources_consulted: General sports analytics literature on championship probability
